title: To Be Held for a Long Time
summary: La Monte Young's one-line score realised as a just perfect fifth the browser holds forever.
mechanism: Two Web Audio sine oscillators tuned to the just 3:2 fifth, started with no .stop() scheduled, so the audio render loop sustains them indefinitely; the only visible change is a clock reading AudioContext.currentTime, and no stop control is provided.
references: La Monte Young & Marian Zazeela, Dream House
Martin Creed, Work No. 227: The lights going on and off (2000)
